tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Dobrodošlica, vođo. Ja sam Sensei Hoshi. Naš je klan pronašao skrivenu dolinu u planinama. Izgradimo selo koje nijedan suparnik ne može pronaći.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Tvoja Kovnica novčića kuje novčiće. Kad iznad nje zalebdi novčić, dodirni ga, a zatim Prikupi.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Klan živi od novčića. Dodirni Gradnja i postavi Kovnicu novčića.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Sada ojačaj Utvrdu klana: dodirni dvorac, a zatim Nadogradi.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Nadogradnje traju. Utvrda je gotova za {time}: vrati se tada ili dodirni Dovrši odmah za malo žada.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Suparnički klanovi izvodit će prepade na nas. Izgradi Kunai toranj pokraj Utvrde (Gradnja, pa kartica Obrana): gađa svakog napadača u dometu.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Izgradi Dojo za obuku, Dvorište odreda i Kunai toranj pokraj Utvrde (Gradnja: kartica Vojska, pa kartica Obrana).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Otvori ploču Vojska i obuči nekoliko Shinobija: brze oštrice koje napadaju najbližu zgradu.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: I obuka traje: tvoji su ratnici spremni za {time}. Pričekaj ili dodirni Dovrši obuku za malo žada.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Tvoj prvi prepad. Dodirni Napad, pregledaj metu, a zatim Napadni! Na bojištu ću ti pokazivati jedno po jedno: pošalji Shinobije kroz točku koja svijetli, a zatim ih zavij u dim kad stignu do tornja: ratnike u dimu moguće je pogoditi samo izbliza.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Dobra borba. Prepadi brzo pune tvoja skladišta: zato sljedeće nadogradi Utvrdu klana (ili neko skladište). Zatim nadogradi Dojo za obuku da otključaš Sabotere: oni na nekoliko sekundi onesposobe obranu. Prvo onesposobi, zatim udari, a ratnike zavij u dim ondje gdje je vatra najjača. Prikupljaj, nadograđuj, izvodi prepade i pridruži se Savezu.

codex.rivalsRule.en: Computer rival clans read your last {n} raids: about {pct} of their outposts are tempered against the warriors you used most.

codex.exhaustionRule.en: For {hours} hours after each raid your village loses, the next raider can take only {pct} as much (two losses multiply).

codex.temperRule.en: From Clan Keep {level}, defenses can be tempered: Reach shoots farther but softer, Blast hits groups but fires slower, Watch strengthens air defense and traps. Each rival clan leans one way:

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Isporuka počinje odmah: prva se isplata može preuzeti sada, a po jedna svaki sljedeći dan; kupnjom pristaješ da gubiš pravo na odustanak, kako zakon dopušta za digitalni sadržaj.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Kupnje trenutačno nisu dostupne. Pokušaj ponovno kasnije.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Kupnja nije uspjela. Ako ti je nešto naplaćeno, isporučuje se čim trgovina to potvrdi.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: To je selo već bilo pod štitom.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Nijedan se ratnik nije borio, pa se to računa kao vježba.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Oblikuj sve zgrade vrste {building} odjednom. Domet gađa dalje, ali slabije i najprije cilja ratnike u stražnjem redu; Prasak pogađa skupine, ali puca sporije; Straža jača Toranj nebeskog luka, Žeravnik gorkog dima i zamke. Napadači vide oblik kad izviđaju.

temper.locked.text: Kaljenje se otvara na razini {level} Utvrde klana.

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Kaljeno: sve zgrade vrste {building} imaju novi oblik.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Straža također slabi liječenje, oživljavanje, izdržljivost i zaštitu štitom napadača u cijeloj bazi.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Najavi rezultat prije napada: ostvariš li ga, nosiš kući više plijena; promašiš li, ne nosiš ništa.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Ulog promašen: najava je bila {stars}★, pa kući nije stigao plijen.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Tvoj je odred odnio {pct} plijena. Odredi s više uloga nose više.

carry.preview.en: This army would carry {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.
raid.rejected.conflict.text: Protivnik se promijenio u istom trenutku.

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.

res.debt.text: Dug iz kupnje za koju je vraćen novac: {amount} {resource}. Otplaćuje se iz tvojih budućih prihoda; ništa drugo se ne uzima.

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Poruke operatera igre stižu kad igraš na mreži.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Ne igraš više na ovom telefonu ili pregledniku? Odjavi ga. Tvoj mrežni račun ostaje za ostale uređaje i povezane prijave.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Igra na mreži ovdje se isključuje, a ovaj uređaj zaboravlja ključ tvojeg mrežnog računa. Selo na ovom uređaju ostaje. Za ponovno igranje s tim računom ovdje prijavi se povezanim računom Apple, Google ili Game Center.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: Ovaj je uređaj odjavljen. Igra na mreži ovdje je isključena.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: Nije odjavljeno: ovaj uređaj ima jedini ključ tvojeg mrežnog računa. Najprije poveži Apple, Google ili Game Center ili umjesto toga izbriši račun.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: U tvojem selu na poslužitelju nije bilo dovoljno resursa.

news.reason.builder.text: Nijedan Seoski majstor nije bio slobodan.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.
news.reason.maxLevel.text: Najviša razina već je bila dosegnuta.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.
news.reason.gone.text: To više nije bilo u tvojem selu.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.
news.reason.busy.text: Radovi su već bili u tijeku.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.army.text: Tvoja Dvorišta odreda bila su puna.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Tvoje se selo već promijenilo, na primjer na drugom uređaju.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Skladište je prepuno: ako sada otkažeš, izgubit ćeš {lost} od povrata {refund}. Najprije oslobodi mjesto.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: Ljestvice su dio igre na mreži.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Napadači mogu uzeti {pct} onoga što drže tvoja skladišta, nikad više od {cap} svakog resursa dok je tvoja Utvrda na razini {level}, te {collectors} onoga što tvoji sakupljači još nisu prikupili.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Dok se nadograđuje ({time}), ništa ne proizvodi. Ono što sada drži ostaje i još se može prikupiti.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}

keep.armyBehind.en: Your warriors' training is more than a Keep behind your village: a higher Keep meets stronger rivals and raiders. Research or train first?
keep.armyBehind.text: Obuka tvojih ratnika zaostaje za selom više od jedne razine Utvrde: viša Utvrda donosi jače suparnike i napadače. Najprije istraživanje ili obuka?

scout.lootWontFit.en: Your storage cannot hold all the loot on offer: what does not fit is lost.
scout.lootWontFit.text: Tvoja skladišta ne mogu primiti sav ponuđeni plijen: ono što ne stane propada.

trials.caughtUp.en: Tiers {from} to {to} are counted as cleared too, each paid once.
trials.caughtUp.text: Razine od {from} do {to} također se računaju kao prijeđene, svaka plaćena jednom.

drill.title.text: Dnevna vježba (vježba: ništa se ne troši)

drill.about.en: Daily drill: fight this fortress with a full camp of your own warriors. Nothing is spent, and today's first drill pays a small reward.
drill.about.text: Dnevna vježba: napadni ovu utvrdu s punim Dvorištem odreda vlastitih ratnika. Ništa se ne troši, a prva vježba svakog dana donosi malu nagradu.

drill.paid.en: Drill done: today's reward is paid. Nothing was spent.
drill.paid.text: Vježba završena: današnja nagrada je isplaćena. Ništa nije potrošeno.

drill.doneToday.en: Today's drill reward is already paid. You can still drill for practice; the next reward comes tomorrow.
drill.doneToday.text: Današnja nagrada za vježbu već je isplaćena. I dalje možeš vježbati; sljedeća nagrada stiže sutra.

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.
scout.shieldEnds.text: Tvom štitu preostaje još {time}: napad ga prekida.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Tvoja prva dnevna škrinja je spremna: „Završi“ je otvara.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Ovo se nije moglo otvoriti. Provjeri vezu i pokušaj ponovno.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Izašla je novija inačica igre Kagemura. Ponovno učitaj da ovo otvoriš.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Ovaj je telefon sporo iscrtavao bitke, pa će Kagemura od sljedećeg pokretanja upotrebljavati lakšu grafiku. To možeš promijeniti u Postavke → Grafika.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Raspored koji je poslao poslužitelj igre. Svako odbrojavanje je stvarno.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Ugrađeni raspored. Svako odbrojavanje je stvarno.

events.fixed.en: Events follow a fixed calendar: a four-week cycle plus five festivals on fixed dates each year. Their times never move or get extended, so the countdown is always the real one.
events.fixed.text: Događaji prate stalan kalendar: ciklus od četiri tjedna i pet festivala na iste datume svake godine. Njihova se vremena nikad ne pomiču ni produljuju, pa je odbrojavanje uvijek stvarno.

contract.about.en: The same for everyone today; a new one in {time}. It changes only what a won raid carries home.
contract.about.text: Danas isti za sve; novi stiže za {time}. Mijenja samo ono što dobiveni prepad donosi kući.

events.gauntlet.about.en: A computer-made fortress, the same base for everyone at your Keep this week. No loot inside; each star mark on the ladder pays once.
events.gauntlet.about.text: Računalno stvorena tvrđava, ista baza za sve na tvojoj razini Utvrde ovaj tjedan. Unutra nema plijena; svaka oznaka zvjezdica na ljestvici isplaćuje se jednom.

events.festival.about.en: A computer-made fortress at your Keep, the same for every attempt. No loot inside; each mark on the ladder pays once, and three stars give the festival's look.
events.festival.about.text: Računalno stvorena tvrđava za tvoju razinu Utvrde, ista u svakom pokušaju. Unutra nema plijena; svaka oznaka na ljestvici isplaćuje se jednom, a tri zvjezdice donose izgled festivala.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Kad osoba koja je počela igrati s tvojim kodom prijatelja dosegne Utvrdu {keep} sa svojim selom na poslužitelju, svatko od vas dobiva fiksnu nagradu. Ništa nasumično i ništa za kupnju.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade
growth.invite.reward.text: Nagrada za svakoga od vas: žad ({jade})

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, one {Nagrade za najviše # prijatelja mjesečno.} few {Nagrade za najviše # prijatelja mjesečno.} other {Nagrade za najviše # prijatelja mjesečno.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Pridruživanja s tvojim kodom: na čekanju {waiting}, spremno {ready}, nagrađeno {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: Tvoje je pridruživanje bilo s kodom prijatelja. Dosegni Utvrdu {keep} sa svojim selom na poslužitelju i nagradu dobiva svatko od vas.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: Tvoje je pridruživanje bilo s kodom prijatelja i Utvrda {keep} je dosegnuta: tvoja nagrada je spremna.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: Tvoje je pridruživanje bilo s kodom prijatelja i tvoja je nagrada prikupljena.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Nagrade idu selu na poslužitelju. Premjesti svoje selo onamo u Postavke → Igra na mreži.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Nagrade za pozivanje prijatelja samo su za odrasle. I dalje možeš dodavati prijatelje i igrati zajedno.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, one {Unesi kôd prijatelja u roku od # dana od početka igre na mreži.} few {Unesi kôd prijatelja u roku od # dana od početka igre na mreži.} other {Unesi kôd prijatelja u roku od # dana od početka igre na mreži.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, one {Poslužitelj provjerava ovu snimku i čuva je # dan pod kodom. Svatko s poveznicom može je gledati. Baza se prikazuje bez imena, a ime protivnika nikad se ne navodi.} few {Poslužitelj provjerava ovu snimku i čuva je # dana pod kodom. Svatko s poveznicom može je gledati. Baza se prikazuje bez imena, a ime protivnika nikad se ne navodi.} other {Poslužitelj provjerava ovu snimku i čuva je # dana pod kodom. Svatko s poveznicom može je gledati. Baza se prikazuje bez imena, a ime protivnika nikad se ne navodi.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: Tvoje se ime ne prikazuje na snimkama koje dijele igrači mlađi od 18 godina.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: Ova se podijeljena snimka nije mogla otvoriti.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: Ova je snimka zabilježena po drugim pravilima bitke, pa je ova inačica igre ne može prikazati.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Stijegovi mijenjaju samo izgled Saveza: bez prednosti u bitci ili resursima.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Šalje i odmak tvoje vremenske zone od UTC-a, kako bi se dani brojili po tvojem kalendaru.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Pregled: ovo još nije u igri.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Odaberi junaka koji se pridružuje tvojim napadima.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Još se nijedan junak ne može pridružiti. Junaci se pridružuju na višim razinama Utvrde.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Napadaj sa svojim ratnicima da stekneš majstorstvo.

seal.progress.en: Keep seal: {n} of {total} buildings at this Keep's cap. A full Keep earns its seal.
seal.progress.text: Pečat Utvrde: {n} od {total} zgrada na najvišoj razini ove Utvrde. Puna Utvrda zaslužuje svoj pečat.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Uvjeti korištenja igre Kagemura vrijede od {date}. Pročitaj ih i prihvati za igru na mreži. Tvoje selo na ovom uređaju radi u svakom slučaju.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Pomozi Appleu u odlučivanju o zahtjevima za povrat novca (isključeno dok ne uključiš)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Kad od Applea zatražiš povrat novca, Apple nas može pitati o kupnji. Ako je ovo uključeno, Appleu javljamo da je kupnja isporučena i dajemo raspone za starost tvojeg računa te iznos tvojih kupnji i povrata novca. Nikad tvoje ime, selo ni razgovor. Nikad ne tražimo od Applea da odbije povrat novca.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Dopusti moju bazu u snimkama koje dijele drugi igrači

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Kad netko podijeli snimku prepada na tvoje selo, ona prikazuje raspored tvoje baze (nikad tvoje ime). Ako ovo isključiš, tvoja se baza nikad ne prikazuje, a već stvorena dijeljenja s njom uklanjaju se.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Ovo ažuriranje mijenja način rada igre Kagemura. Roditelj ili skrbnik može ga pregledati prije upotrebe.

season.recap.en: League at season end: {league}. Raids won: {raids}. Stars: {stars}. Scroll tiers: {tiers}.
season.recap.text: Liga na kraju sezone: {league}. Dobiveni prepadi: {raids}. Zvjezdice: {stars}. Stupnjevi svitka: {tiers}.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Sezonski svitak je završio, a nepreuzete nagrade dodane su:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {Prikupljeno je svih {max} bonusa ove sezone ({got} od {max})} one {Svaki se zadatak i dalje isplati: sljedeći bonus za još # bod ({got} od {max} ove sezone)} few {Svaki se zadatak i dalje isplati: sljedeći bonus za još # boda ({got} od {max} ove sezone)} other {Svaki se zadatak i dalje isplati: sljedeći bonus za još # bodova ({got} od {max} ove sezone)}}
